limitations: Only native receipts completed before each rejection contribute timing support.
Replay uses receipt timestamps/order, not exact in-memory callback/ledger ordering or estimator-cache state.
All-prior support is diagnostic, unbounded and potentially stale; it is not an online estimator proposal.
Cold seeds contain no typed FULL-only H2D samples; legacy fallback and live typed samples stay separate.
Do not borrow D2H/foreign-shape timings or use future observations to fill missing support.
Freshness of compatible evidence is reported; no extrapolated time, transfer permit or GPU gain is inferred.
A wait's fitting observation may occur at a different timestamp from rejection; each rejection retains its own free-list status.
